about: Tables for content/home-quotes.json's two readers: frontend/src/tests/content/home-quotes-rules.ts (Jest) and backend/tests/unit/docs/test_homepage_quotes_docs.py (pytest). Each reader runs every case against `files` (a case's own `files` replace those paths; null deletes one) and must give exactly its `refusals`, in order. Every refusal code a reader knows has a case here.

files.docs/capabilities.md:
# What it does

**(beta)** marks a capability its own page calls beta; **(full profile)** marks an optional one.

- [Revenue metrics](limits.md): analysed as its mean value per assigned user.
- [Reading results](guides/results.md): the difference per user with its confidence interval.
- [Sequential testing](sequential.md) (beta): mSPRT with always-valid confidence intervals, so you can read results at any time.
- [Bayesian analysis](bayesian.md): each variant's chance to be best, the expected loss of choosing it, and a stopping recommendation.
- [Bayesian priors at creation](bayesian.md#priors): the prior alpha and beta, loss threshold and credible level.
- [Mutual exclusion groups and a global holdout](groups.md): a user joins at most one experiment of a group (its results are beta).
- [Breakdowns](breakdowns.md): results by a user attribute, flagged when the effect differs between segments.
- [Results for one saved segment](breakdowns.md#one-segment) (Beta, exploratory): counted only for the users in one ID-list segment.
- [Split URL experiments](split.md) (full profile, beta): each variant is its own page.
- [Segments](segments.md): a named group of users, by rules or by an uploaded list (adding and removing ids is beta).
- [Administration](admin.md): users, roles and the audit log, which downloads as CSV or JSON (the download is beta).
- [Tool installer](tool.md) (beta): one command that runs the steps for you, for the core profile in `us-west-2`.
